summary: A step-by-step introduction to cognitive diagnostic models, from attributes and the Q-matrix to the mastery profile each student receives.

episodes.title: Same Score, Different Needs
episodes.summary: Two students earn the same total score. Do they need the same help? This episode compares total scores, item response theory and CDM, builds a Q-matrix from three attributes, and shows why three attributes give eight possible mastery profiles.

episodes.title: The DINA Model: Why Mastering One Skill Isn’t Enough
episodes.summary: A student has mastered one of the two skills an item requires. Does that raise the chance of a correct answer? Under the DINA model, no. This episode builds the model step by step: the conjunctive rule, the ideal response η, slip and guess, item discrimination, and a worked example in which two students with the same total score have very different chances on one item.

episodes.title: The DINO Model: When One Skill Is Enough
episodes.summary: What if either skill is enough to answer an item? This episode introduces the DINO model, the disjunctive counterpart of DINA: the disjunctive rule, the ideal response ω, slip and guess, and a worked example in which two students with the same total score look different under DINA but identical under DINO. It ends with where DINO fits and why the choice of model should be checked against data.
